Free exam timer

Reading time, writing time, the subject and the date, large enough to read from the back of the exam hall. Several papers with different end times can share one screen.

Open full screenChange the times, sound and look

How to use the exam timer

  1. Open the settings and type in the subject, paper, date and start time.
  2. Set the reading time (10 minutes to start with) and the writing time.
  3. Writing in one venue with other papers? Add them: each gets its own writing time and end time.
  4. Press Full screen and put it on the projector. The timer starts at the start time.

For a link you can save and reuse, set the exam up in the timer settings.

Made for the exam hall

  • Reading time first. The reading time counts down, then the writing time starts on its own.
  • Several papers in one venue. Up to twelve papers on one screen, listed like a departure board: the next paper to finish at the top, and papers that end together share one row.
  • Clear warnings. The time turns amber in the last minutes, and a paper that has finished shows “Pens down” for a few seconds.
  • Safe from accidents. If the page is refreshed or the laptop restarts, the timer picks up from the right time.
  • Analogue or digital. A large clock face beside the papers, or digits alone, in your own colours.

Questions

Is the exam timer free for schools?

Yes. Any school can use it for free, with no account and nothing to install. It runs in a browser on the computer connected to the projector.

Can different papers end at different times?

Yes. Papers in the same venue share the start time and reading time, but each can have its own writing time, so each shows its own end time and time left.

What happens if the computer restarts during an exam?

The timer works from the clock, not from when the page was opened. Open the same link again and it shows the correct time left.

Does it show the reading time?

Yes. The reading time counts down first, with its own heading, and the writing time starts automatically when it ends.
